candidates.subject: Lionel Messi
candidates.selection: A globally searched football journey with a documented arc from Rosario and Barcelona at thirteen through record-setting club years, international heartbreak and the 2022 World Cup resolution.
candidates.working_title: Lionel Messi: The Long Road to the World Cup
candidates.opening_hook: For years, the greatest prize in football was the one achievement his career still could not answer.
candidates.central_dramatic_question: How did Lionel Messi carry record-breaking brilliance and repeated international disappointment until Argentina's World Cup victory finally changed the meaning of his journey?

reference_stages.appearance: recognisable child identity with age-appropriate proportions and dark hair
reference_stages.equipment: simple mid-1990s youth football clothing and ball with no logos

reference_stages.appearance: recognisable early-teen identity, small age-appropriate build
reference_stages.equipment: plain turn-of-the-century academy training kit with no crests or sponsors

reference_stages.appearance: recognisable teenage identity with era-accurate longer hair
reference_stages.equipment: plain 2005 competition kit, boots and ball without branding

reference_stages.appearance: recognisable adult identity with era-accurate hair and athletic build
reference_stages.equipment: plain 2014 Argentina-colour kit without crest, sponsor or readable marks

reference_stages.appearance: recognisable mature identity with era-accurate beard and hair
reference_stages.equipment: plain 2022 Argentina-colour kit and ball without protected marks

direction_requirements.rear_view_cap: no more than 15 percent and never consecutive
direction_requirements.anatomy_gate: Messi is left-footed; reject mirrored mechanics, malformed hands, feet, joints or duplicated limbs.

factual_guardrails: Do not invent private medical, family, financial or academy conversations.
Do not narrate exact childhood routines or motives unless the linked source supports them.
Treat visuals as original CGI reconstructions, not archival footage.
Preserve documented left-footed football mechanics across shots.
